testcase.name: Scenario: Select an overflowed tab while the ribbon is minimized to tabs: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:354:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select an overflowed tab while the ribbon is minimized to tabs ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with Tools active in tabs-only ribbon display ✔ And the narrow application window places View in the tab overflow menu ✔ When the user opens the tab overflow menu and selects View ✔ Then the overflow menu closes ✔ And no temporary ribbon command panel opens ✔ And the part remains visible ✔ When the user maximizes the application window ✔ Then View is visible as the active tab ✔ And the ribbon remains in tabs-only display
